record.body:
## Rationale

Finished milestones add noise once an effort has many phases. Collapsing them by default keeps the home screen on the live roadmap while still allowing expand for history. The milestone that contains the selected (or default) phase stays expanded so the user never loses their place.

## Counter-argument

Leaving every milestone expanded would show the full history without an extra click. That was rejected because it fights the calm-home principle that motivated this milestone.

payload.alternatives: All milestones expanded; Collapse all including the current one
payload.choice: Finished milestones collapsed by default; milestone containing the selected or default phase stays expanded
